text:
Jordan (AE): Quick handover for Orchid — signed yesterday. High-level: midmarket, pilot starts next week, wants private eval in their GCP VPC, SSO (Okta), and dedicated throughput for peak inference. I left notes on the contract about a 12mo term; renewal touchpoint in ~9 months. Sharing context + asks below.

Priya (CSM): Thanks — adding context: primary contacts are Sara (PM) and Tom (Infra). Current goals = 1) proof-of-concept for chat generation with PII redaction, 2) 100k tokens/day baseline, 3) integrate SSO and audit logs for compliance. Risk: they mentioned potential competitors in procurement — if onboarding stalls past 30d they said they'd reevaluate. Need a crisp launch plan.

Jordan (AE): Owners proposal: Priya = CS lead, Riley = SE for infra/ingest, Ethan = Support triage/eng escalation. First milestones: confirm VPC peering details by Mon EOD, Okta metadata and assertion test by Wed, and pilot traffic ramp plan by next Fri.

Riley (Solutions Eng): Noted. Will need the following from the customer to start private eval and NAT setup:
```
- customer project id
- VPC name and CIDR ranges (both sides)
- list of allowed egress IPs (if they have IP whitelisting)
- Okta IdP metadata XML + SP ACS URL
- sample payload size and expected max seq len
```
Can @Priya share Sara/Tom contact and ask them to provide these? Also need to know if they want KV-cache persistence across restarts.

Priya (CSM): Looping Sara & Tom now (cc'ing emails). Sara said they'll send project id + VPC CIDRs by EOD tomorrow. KV-cache = yes (they want session continuity).

Ethan (Lead Support): I'll open a support/eng intake and scaffold an internal ticket for the VPC/peering + cert work and another for SSO. Creating ENG-OPS ticket and linking here. Expected initial triage in 24h.

oncall-bot: ticket #IN-6241 created: "Orchid private eval - VPC peering & certs" assigned to Ethan. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IN-6241

Ethan (Lead Support): Quick notes for triage — asking Eng for network ACL rules and whether they require a dedicated subnet. If customer CIDR overlaps we'll need a workaround (NAT or proxy). For Okta: need SAML attributes mapping for 'email' and 'team' to set up RBAC.

Jordan (AE): Renewal / commercial flag: mark as "watch" — high potential but risk if pilot is delayed >30d. Priya please set a weekly health sync for first 6 weeks; escalate to AM if we see sign of procurement re-evaluation.

Priya (CSM): Will do. Weekly 30m sync, first meeting Thursday. I'll capture feedback from PO and product team during the pilot and open a feedback doc in Confluence — will share link here once created.

Riley (Solutions Eng): One more infra ask: sample inference qps and batch sizes. If they're targeting 100k tokens/day, what's the qps distribution? Even rough hourly distribution helps sizing.

Priya (CSM): Sara said expected peak qps ~ 8-10 during business hours, mostly short chats (avg 60 tokens). I'll confirm and post figures.

Ethan (Lead Support): Action items summary (assignments + rough ETA):
- Ethan: create ENG-OPS tickets + initial triage (done) -> by today
- Riley: infra runbook + required network config snippet -> draft by Mon EOD
- Priya: collect customer network + Okta metadata -> ask Sara/Tom, update thread when received -> by tomorrow EOD
- Jordan: commercial notes and renewal watch -> flagged in CRM -> done

Priya (CSM): Adding a note to track win criteria: 1) SSO enabled and tested, 2) private eval receives >= 7 days of stable traffic, 3) no critical latency/regression compared to baseline.

Jordan (AE): Thanks team :pray: — if any blockers ping me directly.

Riley (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a short runbook snippet to paste here (network + certs) once I have the customer CIDRs.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Orchid weekly health sync" created for Thu 10:00 AM PST.

Ethan (Lead Support): I'll update IN-6241 with any new findings and link the SSO ticket when created.

Priya (CSM): Putting this in my calendar and will share the Confluence link after the first sync. Keeping high priority. :white_check_mark:
